column1: Kunimitsu is the first new addition to Season 3, continuing her new era of Kunoichi, succeeding her Mother. She's a fast, poking-oriented character who can strike at any range from anywhere. She can leverage "[Setsunagake (SET/f+3)](f+3)" to rush towards her opponent to begin close-quarters offence. Against opponents that are eager to retaliate, "[Katon (KAT/1+2)](1+2)" is a mix-up-heavy stance she can use after key pokes like "1,1" or "2,2" to manoeuvre her out of the way of incoming strikes and into the air, utilising moves like "[Veil of Night (KAT.2)](KAT.2)" or "[Leaping Moon Blade (KAT.3,2)](KAT.3,2)" to surprise her opponents. With her trusty kunai, Kunimitsu can snipe her opponents from across the screen with her "[Savage Kunai Throw (qcf+1)](qcf+1)", or airborne targets with "[Cloud Scorching Blossoms (u+1/uf+1)](uf+1)". Kunimitsu's mission in a fight is to always keep her opponent guessing what her next action is as she deploys her fast movement, strong mixups, and tricky 50/50's to always have the upper hand.

column1: She doesn't have many flaws in her kit and is generally well-rounded; However, Kunimitsu can struggle a bit due to her having to play many interactions; failure to perform her technical punishment can cost you, given the risk that is involved. But if you're diligent in your training and are interested in her take on fast-paced and trickster-esque Tekken, then Kunimitsu is the character for you.

"Polarising Full Crouch and Backturn Mix:" Kunimitsu's core game plan is to mix up the opponent. Using tools like "d+1" and "hFC.1+2" puts Kunimitsu in situations where she forces the opponent to play her game.

"Strong Movement:" Equipped with a strong backdash and tools like "[SET](f+3)" to quickly cover distance towards her opponent, Kunimitsu can effortlessly move around the stage, creating a lot of opportunities for herself in a match.

"Gifted Punishment:" Kunimitsu is able to heavily punish mistakes regardless of whether she's standing or crouching with hard-to-perform 10F punisher "f,f+4,2" that wall-splats opponents, to "f,d,df+2" which can be buffered to launch moves at 14F's.

"Struggles to prevent movement:" Kunimitsu has limited options to deal with opponents who are actively moving against her due to her close-range options tracking to the right and her long-range options tracking to the left. The actions that she uses to stop this from happening are either weak ("df+4"), carry risk to them ("3,4"), or are slow ("qcf+1+2").
"Compulsive Gambler:" Kunimitsu has to consistently win multiple interactions in neutral, which can provide opportunities for the opponent to counter-hit her or apply their own aggression.

Kunimitsu's heat improves her ability to force backturn mix-ups with "H.u+1+2". Kunimitsu also gains an extremely evasive low from KAT stance with "H.KAT.d+1+2". She also gains access to a new safe launcher with "H.db+1+2".
Kunimitsu can also perform her Heat Smash "[Flame Riot: Lunar Mirror](H.2+3)", which is a very powerful 14F heat smash that will splat and instantly break through destructible walls.
